## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) to the single [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) it documents — the link from description to the model that a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) actually uses.

### Avoid when

- Avoid describing two agents with one card (it is functional — a card describes exactly one model) and avoid using it as the invocation's model link (that is [`gmeow:usedModel`](gmeow-usedModel.md)).

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:describesModel`](gmeow-describesModel.md) per [`ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) at the [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md); the same agent is reached from an invocation via [`gmeow:usedModel`](gmeow-usedModel.md).
